decision.purpose: Answer “what spatial/result entity is being inspected?” while preserving current task drawer and map context.
decision.model: Read-only context with actions that route to existing task owners.

candidates.why: Stable spatial identity and most frequent switch from map/plan to Inventory. Current TowerInspector is only five facts and misses effective RF profile/provenance.
show: Cell ID and physical/site identity only where distinct
Effective TX power, azimuth, beam width, radius only when resolved from current plan
Active transmitter / cluster membership as separate statuses
Current result/source Run/freshness when an exact relation exists
do_not: Set serving cell or add to cluster because the inspector opened

candidates.why: A spatially selected building can require source, AGL, terrain, facade and compatibility context. Current BuildingInspector performs lazy spatial-evidence fetch and must keep its diagnostic-only claim.
show: Planning AGL versus selected evidence AGL
actions: Open Building Entry when a supported current estimate exists
do_not: Infer material loss or canonical RF behavior from evidence alone

candidates.why: Selection-specific RSRP/SINR/RSRQ and serving/interferer context are useful while the Interference task remains visible.
show: Only returned RSRP/SINR/RSRQ values with units
Distance/LOS/wall facts only if present in source output
Model family and exact source Run/freshness
actions: Open path profile when endpoints are supported
do_not: Label a stale value as current

candidates.why: A gap is a map-specific sample with severity, received power, demand and reason; it is compact enough for context detail.
A rendered 5G communication route is spatial and current MapInspector already shows route/status/from/to; keep concise.
do_not: Treat the route as an RF ray or path profile

candidates.why: PathProfilePanel is a workflow with endpoints and calculation; no stable selected ray/sample entity was verified for a generic inspector contract.
show: Nothing until a stable map feature identity and result payload exist
actions: Open existing Propagation > Advanced path-profile workflow

candidates.why: MapCanvas renders a raster/grid overlay with no stable clickable point feature. Adding point sampling is a separate map behavior/design decision.
actions: Use aggregate legend and surface controls
do_not: Sample pixels or interpolate values without defined scientific semantics

candidates.why: Current MapInspector can show measured/predicted RSRP and residual; it is useful, but it belongs to an isolated validation evidence source and needs validation/source freshness context.
show: Measured/predicted RSRP/residual only from retained sample payload

candidates.why: Map point is spatial, but candidate ranking/reason and apply behavior belong to Results; keep map interaction as a shortcut into the selected candidate in Results.
show: Candidate ID and one-line reason only if the current marker stays selectable
do_not: Duplicate candidate scoring/detail and Apply workflow

candidates.why: Not inherently spatial; current Results already owns recommended-versus-selected candidate state, objective detail, configuration deltas, comparison and Apply action.
show: Keep full selected-candidate detail inside Results master/detail
actions: Existing Apply solution flow from exact source Run
do_not: Duplicate selectedSolutionId in inspector or use inspector as the only comparison surface

candidates.why: Run History is a browsing/history task, not an entity selected from the spatial canvas.
show: Compact source Run badge in spatial inspector only when a sample comes from it
actions: View Run opens Review > Run History
do_not: Move full Run metadata into right inspector

candidates.why: Report lifecycle, byte integrity, source binding, download and deletion belong to Reports.
do_not: Load report tools or bytes from map selection

candidates.why: No stable user-facing selected demand entity/geometry contract was verified in the current map behavior.
do_not: Add new demand-point selection state as part of 8E

exclusions: Any inspector edit form that duplicates Inventory or Results
